versos.grego: Σὺ οὖν, τέκνον μου, ἐνδυναμοῦ ἐν τῇ χάριτι τῇ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ,

controles.web: You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
controles.kjv: Thou therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
controles.livre: Portanto tu, meu filho, fortifica-te na graça que há em Cristo Jesus.

versos.grego: καὶ ἃ ἤκουσας παρ’ ἐμοῦ διὰ πολλῶν μαρτύρων, ταῦτα παράθου πιστοῖς ἀνθρώποις, οἵτινες ἱκανοὶ ἔσονται καὶ ἑτέρους διδάξαι.

controles.web: The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same to faithful men, who will be able to teach others also.
controles.kjv: And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.
controles.livre: E o que de mim ouviste entre muitas testemunhas, confia-o a pessoas fiéis, que sejam competentes para ensinar também a outros.

versos.grego: συνκακοπάθησον ὡς καλὸς στρατιώτης Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ.

controles.web: You therefore must endure hardship, as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
controles.kjv: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.
controles.livre: Sofre comigo as aflições como bom soldado de Cristo Jesus.

versos.grego: οὐδεὶς στρατευόμενος ἐμπλέκεται ταῖς τοῦ βίου πραγματείαις, ἵνα τῷ στρατολογήσαντι ἀρέσῃ.

controles.web: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.
controles.kjv: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.
controles.livre: Nenhum soldado em batalha se envolve com assuntos desta vida, pois tem como objetivo agradar àquele que o alistou.

versos.grego: ἐὰν δὲ καὶ ἀθλῇ τις, οὐ στεφανοῦται ἐὰν μὴ νομίμως ἀθλήσῃ.

controles.web: Also, if anyone competes in athletics, he isn’t crowned unless he has competed by the rules.
controles.kjv: And if a man also strive for masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.
controles.livre: E, também, se alguém está competindo como atleta, não recebe a coroa se não seguir as regras.

versos.grego: τὸν κοπιῶντα γεωργὸν δεῖ πρῶτον τῶν καρπῶν μεταλαμβάνειν.

controles.web: The farmers who labor must be the first to get a share of the crops.
controles.kjv: The husbandman that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits.
controles.livre: O lavrador que trabalha deve ser o primeiro a receber da partilha dos frutos.

versos.grego: νόει ὃ λέγω· δώσει γάρ σοι ὁ Κύριος σύνεσιν ἐν πᾶσιν.

controles.web: Consider what I say, and may the Lord give you understanding in all things.
controles.kjv: Consider what I say; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things.
controles.livre: Considera o que digo; pois o Senhor te dará entendimento em tudo.

versos.grego: Μνημόνευε Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν ἐγηγερμένον ἐκ νεκρῶν, ἐκ σπέρματος Δαυείδ, κατὰ τὸ εὐαγγέλιόν μου·

controles.web: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, of the seed of David, according to my Good News,
controles.kjv: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel:
controles.livre: Lembra-te de Jesus Cristo, ressuscitado dos mortos, da descendência  de Davi, segundo o meu evangelho.

versos.grego: ἐν ᾧ κακοπαθῶ μέχρι δεσμῶν ὡς κακοῦργος, ἀλλὰ ὁ λόγος τοῦ Θεοῦ οὐ δέδεται.

controles.web: in which I suffer hardship to the point of chains as a criminal. But God’s word isn’t chained.
controles.kjv: Wherein I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, even unto bonds; but the word of God is not bound.
controles.livre: Por esse evangelho sofro aflições, e até prisões, como um criminoso; mas a palavra de Deus não está presa.

versos.grego: διὰ τοῦτο πάντα ὑπομένω διὰ τοὺς ἐκλεκτούς, ἵνα καὶ αὐτοὶ σωτηρίας τύχωσιν τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ μετὰ δόξης αἰωνίου.

controles.web: Therefore I endure all things for the chosen ones’ sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
controles.kjv: Therefore I endure all things for the elect’s sakes, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
controles.livre: Por isso tudo suporto por causa dos escolhidos, a fim de que também eles obtenham a salvação que está em Cristo Jesus com glória eterna.

versos.grego: Πιστὸς ὁ λόγος· εἰ γὰρ συναπεθάνομεν, καὶ συζήσομεν·

controles.web: This saying is faithful:  “For if we died with him, we will also live with him.
controles.kjv: It is a faithful saying: For if we be dead with him, we shall also live with him:
controles.livre: Esta afirmação é fiel: se morrermos com ele , também com ele viveremos;

versos.grego: εἰ ὑπομένομεν, καὶ συνβασιλεύσομεν· εἰ ἀρνησόμεθα, κἀκεῖνος ἀρνήσεται ἡμᾶς·

controles.web: If we endure, we will also reign with him. If we deny him, he also will deny us.
controles.kjv: If we suffer, we shall also reign with him: if we deny him, he also will deny us:
controles.livre: se sofrermos, também com ele reinaremos; se o negarmos, também ele nos negará;

versos.grego: εἰ ἀπιστοῦμεν, ἐκεῖνος πιστὸς μένει, ἀρνήσασθαι γὰρ ἑαυτὸν οὐ δύναται.

controles.web: If we are faithless, he remains faithful. He can’t deny himself.”
controles.kjv: If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.
controles.livre: se formos infiéis, ele continua fiel; porque ele não pode negar a si mesmo.

versos.grego: Ταῦτα ὑπομίμνῃσκε, διαμαρτυρόμενος ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ μὴ λογομαχεῖν, ἐπ’ οὐδὲν χρήσιμον, ἐπὶ καταστροφῇ τῶν ἀκουόντων.

controles.web: Remind them of these things, charging them in the sight of the Lord, that they don’t argue about words, to no profit, to the subverting of those who hear.
controles.kjv: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging them before the Lord that they strive not about words to no profit, but to the subverting of the hearers.
controles.livre: Lembra-os disso, alertando-os diante de Deus, que não tenham brigas de palavras, que não têm proveito algum, a não ser para a ruína dos ouvintes.

versos.grego: σπούδασον σεαυτὸν δόκιμον παραστῆσαι τῷ Θεῷ, ἐργάτην ἀνεπαίσχυντον, ὀρθοτομοῦντα τὸν λόγον τῆς ἀληθείας.

controles.web: Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn’t need to be ashamed, properly handling the Word of Truth.
controles.kjv: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.
controles.livre: Procura apresentar-te aprovado a Deuscomo um trabalhador que não tem de que se envergonhar, que usa bem a palavra da verdade.

versos.grego: τὰς δὲ βεβήλους κενοφωνίας περιΐστασο· ἐπὶ πλεῖον γὰρ προκόψουσιν ἀσεβείας,

controles.web: But shun empty chatter, for it will go further in ungodliness,
controles.kjv: But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness.
controles.livre: Mas evita conversas profanas e inútes; pois tendem a produzir maior irreverência.

versos.grego: καὶ ὁ λόγος αὐτῶν ὡς γάγγραινα νομὴν ἕξει· ὧν ἐστιν Ὑμέναιος καὶ Φιλητός,

controles.web: and those words will consume like gangrene, of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus;
controles.kjv: And their word will eat as doth a canker: of whom is Hymeneus and Philetus;
controles.livre: E a palavra deles se espalhará como uma gangrena; entre os quais são Himeneu e Fileto.

versos.grego: οἵτινες περὶ τὴν ἀλήθειαν ἠστόχησαν, λέγοντες ἀνάστασιν ἤδη γεγονέναι, καὶ ἀνατρέπουσιν τήν τινων πίστιν.

controles.web: men who have erred concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past, and overthrowing the faith of some.
controles.kjv: Who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already; and overthrow the faith of some.
controles.livre: Esses se desviaram da verdade, dizendo que a ressurreição já aconteceu; e perverteram a fé de alguns.

versos.grego: ὁ μέντοι στερεὸς θεμέλιος τοῦ Θεοῦ ἕστηκεν, ἔχων τὴν σφραγῖδα ταύτην Ἔγνω Κύριος τοὺς ὄντας αὐτοῦ, καί Ἀποστήτω ἀπὸ ἀδικίας πᾶς ὁ ὀνομάζων τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου.

controles.web: However God’s firm foundation stands, having this seal, “The Lord knows those who are his,” and, “Let every one who names the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.”
controles.kjv: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.
controles.livre: Porém o fundamento de Deus continua firme, e tem este selo:  o Senhor conhece os que são seus, e que todo aquele que faz uso do nome do Senhor, se afaste da injustiça.

versos.grego: ἐν μεγάλῃ δὲ οἰκίᾳ οὐκ ἔστιν μόνον σκεύη χρυσᾶ καὶ ἀργυρᾶ, ἀλλὰ καὶ ξύλινα καὶ ὀστράκινα, καὶ ἃ μὲν εἰς τιμὴν ἃ δὲ εἰς ἀτιμίαν·

controles.web: Now in a large house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of clay. Some are for honor, and some for dishonor.
controles.kjv: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.
controles.livre: Numa grande casa não há somente utensílios de ouro e de prata, mas também de madeira e de barro; e uns para honra, porém outros para desonra.

versos.grego: ἐὰν οὖν τις ἐκκαθάρῃ ἑαυτὸν ἀπὸ τούτων, ἔσται σκεῦος εἰς τιμήν, ἡγιασμένον, εὔχρηστον τῷ δεσπότῃ, εἰς πᾶν ἔργον ἀγαθὸν ἡτοιμασμένον.

controles.web: If anyone therefore purges himself from these, he will be a vessel for honor, sanctified, and suitable for the master’s use, prepared for every good work.
controles.kjv: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master’s use, and prepared unto every good work.
controles.livre: Portanto, se alguém se purificar destas coisas, será utensílio para honra, santificado e adequado para uso do Dono,  e preparado para toda boa obra.

versos.grego: τὰς δὲ νεωτερικὰς ἐπιθυμίας φεῦγε, δίωκε δὲ δικαιοσύνην, πίστιν, ἀγάπην, εἰρήνην μετὰ τῶν ἐπικαλουμένων τὸν Κύριον ἐκ καθαρᾶς καρδίας.

controles.web: Flee from youthful lusts; but pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
controles.kjv: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
controles.livre: Foge também dos desejos da juventude; e segue a justiça, a fé, o amor, e a paz, com os que, de coração puro, invocam o Senhor.

versos.grego: τὰς δὲ μωρὰς καὶ ἀπαιδεύτους ζητήσεις παραιτοῦ, εἰδὼς ὅτι γεννῶσιν μάχας·

controles.web: But refuse foolish and ignorant questionings, knowing that they generate strife.
controles.kjv: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they do gender strifes.
controles.livre: E rejeita as questões tolas e sem instrução, como sabes que elas produzem brigas.

versos.grego: δοῦλον δὲ Κυρίου οὐ δεῖ μάχεσθαι ἀλλὰ ἤπιον εἶναι πρὸς πάντας, διδακτικόν, ἀνεξίκακον,

controles.web: The Lord’s servant must not quarrel, but be gentle towards all, able to teach, patient,
controles.kjv: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient,
controles.livre: E ao servo do Senhor não convém brigar, mas sim ser manso com todos, apto para ensinar e suportar;

versos.grego: ἐν πραΰτητι παιδεύοντα τοὺς ἀντιδιατιθεμένους, μή ποτε δώῃ αὐτοῖς ὁ Θεὸς μετάνοιαν εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν ἀληθείας,

controles.web: in gentleness correcting those who oppose him: perhaps God may give them repentance leading to a full knowledge of the truth,
controles.kjv: In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if God peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;
controles.livre: deve instruir com mansidão aos que se opõem, pois talvez Deus lhes dê arrependimento para conhecerem a verdade;

versos.grego: καὶ ἀνανήψωσιν ἐκ τῆς τοῦ διαβόλου παγίδος, ἐζωγρημένοι ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸ ἐκείνου θέλημα.

controles.web: and they may recover themselves out of the devil’s snare, having been taken captive by him to his will.
controles.kjv: And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, who are taken captive by him at his will.
controles.livre: e se libertem da armadilha do diabo, em que foram presos à vontade dele.
